findings.message: S1: holding and cutting decisions are declared; this does not approve measured fixture clearance.

hold.clamp: Lay out body-axis centres on BOTH ends; independently offset jaws for centroidZ14.1. Verify each jaw's actual flat contact/reach and28mm axial engagement, tighten/remove key, then isolated-spindle hand-turn full revolution including jaws and fixed toolpost/apron/bed. Qualify low-speed interrupted cuts, imbalance and positive restraint/rigidity;116.1034022 is SWING ONLY, never a round-bar stiffness argument. Trial-turn lower band, micrometer actual diameter and indicate actual cylinder at two stations, reclamp/recheck. No cantilever/balance acceptance inferred from nominal swing.
hold.grip_on: rectangular50.8x76.2 sacrificial tail, modelY94.742..122.742; independent four-jaw contacts offset14.1mm from blank centroid
hold.note: Example layout only: nominal PM-1127VF-LB envelope11in/279.4mm over bed and6.69in/169.926mm over cross-slide exceeds116.1034022mm blank rotation; this excludes jaws/toolpost/adapter and proves neither actual clearance nor balance. Source: examples/inventory/pedro-shop.toml machines.PM-1127VF-LB.envelope (example marker), published PM product specification. Measure installed full swept clearance with spindle isolated; actual jaw grip/contact/stiffness cannot use the swing diameter. Raw head block Y68.072..94.742 stays rectangular and offset through every S1 op, so imbalance is re-qualified before every rpm step.
hold.stop: Example design: four jaw fronts at T1 Z-94.742; tail end atZ-122.742.

findings.message: S1C: holding and cutting decisions are declared; this does not approve measured fixture clearance.

numbers.coolant: none: selected low-speed dry demonstration cut; qualify actual material/blade guidance and descent

hold.clamp: Seat raw head flatmodelX=-25.4 on actual bed,upright50.8 high. Front jaw bearsmodelZ=-24 flat,rear jawmodelZ52.2 flat. JawsTCX[-17.5,92.5] end3.742 beforekerflow96.242,actual raw-head overlapX68.072..92.5. Clamp retained head only; never use a rigid second vise or axial clamp on slug. Qualify positive contacts,bed seating,square and body cantilever. Independently anchor/level continuous outfeed shoe with actualbedZ0,never jack work or close kerf. Set compliant free upperidler nominal15N downward target using qualified force measurement,allow axial float; actual force/deflection unknown until qualified.
hold.grip_on: Actual opposing raw head flats at TCY=-24 and52.2,headX68.072..92.5,Z0..50.8;24.428mm axial overlap on each jaw,not110mm material grip
hold.note: Example geometry only; bandsaw/vise facts unchanged: jawwidth110,height60,opening152,depth12. Real clamping area perjaw24.428x50.8=1240.9424mm2,not110mm axial grip. Turned body belowhead hangs clear,not on an invented plane. Prior twofree rollersX106/116 alone tip atcutdownforce~3.83N and are REJECTED as sole support. Parent's replacement intentionally changes originalallsolidsX>=101/nopreload toshoe front98.75 and compliant15NupperidlerX111. Slugmass~0.760kg is COMPUTED1018density,not weighed;W~7.45N,COM110.242. Shoe front98.75 givesgravitytipthreshold~85N atworstcutedge97.742;upperidler15N adds~182N to~267N nominalstaticlimit. These are analyticaldesignnumbers,not certified loads/friction/dynamic/no-pinch proof. Qualify peakdownfeedforce<=50N and side forces,actualspringload/travel/deflection,shoelevel/contact,bladebow/body/guides atfullcut; if force cannot be bounded or realguideclearance fails,hold this candidate rather than clipping fixtures or assuming clearance. Stop onmovement/binding;raise blade afterfullcut,shut power/wait before slug retrieval.
hold.stop: No rigid stop loads the slug toward the blade. With saw isolated, lay out retained cutface96.242 from actual finished B/modelY0 and place the kept-side blade edge on that line; qualified1.5 kerf places bladecentre96.992. Clamp retained head only, recheck B-to-blade setting and saw square. Physical setting is a layout/length check, not an invented bandsaw DRO zero.

supports.note: Parent-selected candidate physical outfeed shoe/capture in TC coordinates,not borrowed future scrap or primary workholding. Continuous adjustable shoeX98.75..123.5,Y[-31,59],topZ0 bears actual raw slug underside; compliant free-rolling upper idler atX111,nominal15N downward target,presses actual topZ50.8 without rigid axial restraint. Sideguards outsideY[-24,52.2],passive tailstopX>=123 clears rawend122.742. Level/lock shoe to actual saw bed without lifting head. Actual full bladebody/bow/guide travel MUST clear1.008mm nominal front-to-kerf gap; bare plane gap does not prove it. Force/deflection/clearance/no-pinch qualification remains held; complete solids belong to LOCAL candidate inventory artifact,not modified bandsaw facts.

Recheck reference/clock after tightening; no machining force or bore-clamping distortion.
hold.grip_on: finished lower-body modelY1..21 in replaceable liner fitted to actual diameter; inspection restraint only

hold.stop: Finished B on three integral buttons; actual finished A survey mandrel clocks13.0011073536895deg above negative standX, recovering model+X upward. Neither round OD alone nor the pre-A S2 setup establishes this meridian.

cutting-data deep_hole: sfm x sfm_factor past depth_over_dia diameters

example (plausible, not measured); threshold from Machinery's Handbook 27th ed. (Industrial Press, 2004) p.1065: when drilling holes deeper than three times the drill diameter, withdraw the drill (peck feed) at intervals to clear chips and let coolant reach the tip. The handbook gives no deep-hole speed factor, so 0.8 is chosen to keep 80 fpm x 0.8 = 64 fpm inside Table 17 p.1061 traditional HSS drilling speeds 60-100 fpm for plain carbon steels 1006-1026 (60 at 225-275 HB); the UFL MAE Design Lab 'Speeds and Feeds' Example 1A tip (-50% past 3xD) and norsemandrill.com (-45-50% past 4xD) are secondary and would fall below that range. The feed stays at the p.1060 row value

cutting-data deep_hole: sfm x sfm_factor past depth_over_dia diameters

example (plausible, not measured); threshold from Machinery's Handbook 27th ed. (Industrial Press, 2004) p.1065: when drilling holes deeper than three times the drill diameter, withdraw the drill (peck feed) at intervals to clear chips and let coolant reach the tip. The handbook gives no deep-hole speed factor, so 0.8 is chosen to keep 80 fpm x 0.8 = 64 fpm inside Table 17 p.1061 traditional HSS drilling speeds 60-100 fpm for plain carbon steels 1006-1026 (60 at 225-275 HB); the UFL MAE Design Lab 'Speeds and Feeds' Example 1A tip (-50% past 3xD) and norsemandrill.com (-45-50% past 4xD) are secondary and would fall below that range. The feed stays at the p.1060 row value
